findings.title: Missing cache recheck after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: In GetWebAssets, the cache pointer is read under RLock and then the lock is released before acquiring the write lock. After acquiring `entryPointAssetsCacheMu.Lock()`, the function does not recheck whether another goroutine has already populated `entryPointAssetsCache`. In non-development mode, concurrent first-time callers can therefore all observe a nil cache, then each sequentially reload `assets-manifest.json` and overwrite the cache. This causes unnecessary file I/O (and could cause repeated CDN requests if that path is ever enabled). Recheck `cfg.Env != setting.Dev && entryPointAssetsCache != nil` immediately after acquiring the write lock and return the cached value if present.
